_meta.purpose: Lead-magnet registry. One entry per magnet: what it is, where it lives, which posts promote it, and how it converts. Written by the /lead-magnet skill, read by the dashboard funnel view.
_meta.funnel: LinkedIn post -> capture form (LeadMagnetCapture) -> captureLead Cloud Function -> Firestore leadCaptures (upsert-keyed email__cluster, carries UTM) -> PDF served -> [welcome sequence: NOT YET WIRED] -> trial -> activated
_meta.northStar: activatedUsers. Captures are a leading indicator, not the goal.
_meta.knownGap: CLOSED IN CODE 2026-08-05, NOT YET DEPLOYED. sendLeadMagnetWelcome (cipher/functions/src/leadMagnetWelcome.ts) fires on leadCaptures create and schedules a 3-touch sequence (Day 0 deliver / Day 2 prove / Day 5 invite) via Resend. Deliberately NOT the 7-day onboarding drip — that one fires on users/{uid} create and is for trial starts; a PDF download is not a trial start. Clean handoff: if the lead converts, scheduleOnboardingDrip takes over. DEPLOYED 2026-08-06 (sendLeadMagnetWelcome + updated captureLead, us-central1). STILL GATED ON THE KEY: RESEND_API_KEY is NOT set — confirmed from scheduleOnboardingDrip logs, which show '[drip] RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping send' on 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-05. That means the existing 7-day onboarding drip has never sent an email either, and sendLeadMagnetWelcome will behave identically until the key is added to functions/.env (plus RESEND_FROM on a Resend-verified sending domain) and functions are redeployed.
_meta.openIssue: If a lead converts to a trial on Day 1 they receive the remaining lead touches AND the onboarding drip. Resend message ids are logged in welcomeSequenceResult so a future conversion hook can cancel pending sends; that hook does not exist yet. Day 2/5 copy is written to still read sensibly to someone already on trial.
_meta.metricsSource: captures = Firestore leadCaptures count for the cluster. trialStarts / activatedUsers require joining leadCaptures email against the users collection — not yet automated, fill in manually at grading time.
